channel.title: AI Builder's Field Guide — Recently Added
channel.description: A daily-curated wiki of the tools, models, and patterns that AI power-users and builders actually reach for.

item.title: PlugThis
item.description: PlugThis enables users to create custom Chrome extensions by describing desired functionality through natural language prompts. — This tool democratizes browser customization, allowing non-developers to rapidly build and deploy utility-focused mini-applications without coding.

item.title: ZCode
item.description: ZCode is a desktop AI coding agent built by Zhipu.ai, providing a graphical user interface for interacting with LLMs and managing coding tasks. — It offers a desktop-first experience similar to OpenAI's Codex app, serving as an alternative to CLI-centric agents for developers who prefer a visual workflow for AI-assisted coding.

item.title: MiMo Code
item.description: A terminal-native AI coding assistant from Xiaomi MiMo that reads and writes code, runs commands, and maintains project understanding with persistent memory. — It offers a self-improving, open-source alternative to existing AI coding environments, focusing on deep project understanding and efficient agentic workflows.

item.title: GenericAgent
item.description: A minimalist, self-evolving autonomous agent framework that grants LLMs system-level control over a local computer with high token efficiency. — It provides a lean, efficient, and self-improving approach to agent development by evolving skills from a minimal core, offering an alternative to more complex frameworks.

item.title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 (Sol, Terra, Luna)
item.description: OpenAI launched GPT-5.6, a new family of frontier AI models available in three tiers: Sol (top), Terra (mid-range), and Luna (fast, cheap). — This release introduces OpenAI's most capable models to date, with tiered access designed to provide options for various performance and cost requirements.

item.title: Traceforce
item.description: Traceforce provides company-wide security monitoring for AI applications by offering visibility and control over AI app activity and detecting security risks. — It addresses the growing concern of AI-assisted attacks and supply chain risks by providing real-time monitoring and controls that traditional security tools often miss.

item.title: Claude Sonnet 5
item.description: Claude Sonnet 5 is Anthropic's latest agentic model, offering near-Opus performance with improved reasoning and tool use at Sonnet pricing. — It provides advanced agentic capabilities at a more accessible price point than the flagship Opus models, making sophisticated AI agents more economically viable for enterprises.

item.title: Sim
item.description: Sim is an open-source workspace designed for building, deploying, and orchestrating AI agents and their associated workflows. — It provides a centralized environment for agent development and management, streamlining the process compared to assembling disparate tools.
